decision.summary: A cross-axis coherent negative excursion occurs in E and U (stronger) and N (weaker) from index 385 to 395. The event has clear onset and sustained interior, but the return phase is only partial and not fully reversed before index 400; full recovery is outside observed window or ambiguous. No confirmed temporary offset due to unobserved/ambiguous return. No other temporary intervals detected within allowed context [365, 579].

intervals.observation: E and U show a sharp negative multi-sample excursion starting ~385, with E dropping ~3 MAD and U ~2 MAD; N shows a shallower dip (~1 MAD). Recovery begins by 396 but does not fully return to pre-event level by 400. Return is incomplete within allowed context; onset and interior are coherent across axes, but opposing return is unobserved.
